Spike scan — telltale action pack

Generated 2026-10-29 22:02 UTC. Scan window 2026-10-24 → 2026-10-27 vs 7-day baseline; history back to 2026-10-01 for recurrence; today (2026-10-28) so far from hourly data. Exact session counts from ARK_PROD.STARFLEET.PROD_INT_SESSION_SUMMARY (Production keys). Created = sessions carrying the signal combination; verified = of those, sessions that ended verified — a wide gap means it is being stopped, lines on top of each other mean it is getting through.

Today (Oct 28 00-05 UTC, hourly) and Oct 27 (exact)

Read first: dict-3 flag disabled at source

  • g-di-dict-3-match-short-term-threshold-exceeded-1x was edited 2026-10-27 03:05 UTC (m.davies, THR-405) with an impossible extra condition (num_matched == 3 AND == -99), and it is 0 on every key from ~09 UTC Oct 27. So the live TT g-rfc-ct-before-cl-device-param-spoofing-di-dict3-st-1x and the dict-3 + dishort300 candidate (BLUE-7297) no longer fire. The 'stop' of Bank of America Beacon ATM, Microsoft Signup, Wells Fargo, Blizzard and DoorDash on those combos is this edit, not the attacker. Worth asking m.davies whether it was intended; BLUE-7297 cannot be created as drafted while dict-3 is off.

Biggest now

  • Uber SMS (Key 1): key total 6.5M on Oct 27; grease 1.75M and pagebio 1.61M at 0% verified; still ~85-90k/h on both today (437k / 410k in 5h). Fully blocked but the largest volume we have seen. BLUE-7323.
  • Amazon IDS (Key 2): grease 251k and pagebio 220k on Oct 27 (up from ~7k on Oct 26), 14% verified; today 62k / 54k in 5h at 9%.
  • Microsoft Identity Signup (Key 2): webgl 154k on Oct 27 at 0% verified; 10k in 5h today (slowing).
  • gtop100.com: webgl 76k on Oct 27 (4%), 14k in 5h today.

Getting through

  • Adobe Commerce (Key 3): webgl 22k on Oct 27 at 95% verified, 4k in 5h today at 91%.
  • Adobe Sign Up (Key 2): ends-te 11k on Oct 27 (56%), 6.5k in 5h today at 82% - growing; single-click 17k on Oct 27 at 58%.
  • Adobe ARP FF (Key 8): webgl 31k at 81%, ends-te 26k at 57%, grease/pagebio ~23k at 35-40%.
  • Meta Login (Key 2): grease/pagebio verified rose from 11-13% to 59-63% on Oct 27 and 84-97% today - either the traffic turned legitimate or the attack is now passing.

Blocked / other

  • Roblox Game Join (Key 6): ends-te 55k and single-click 22k on Oct 27 at 3-9% verified; 4.8k in 5h today.
  • Roblox Login (Key 1): new on dict-7 + dishort300 + high-risk sig, 4.5k on Oct 27 at 0%.
  • Blizzard Support Site: grease 29k on Oct 27, 3k today, 0% verified.
  • Highlight AI Chat Prompt: grease/pagebio 110k on Oct 26 -> 16k on Oct 27 -> ~0 today (stopped; not a dict-3 combo).

Discovery (Oct 24-27)

  • No new attack combination. Only ja4-dict-1 + dishort300 passed (8 keys), but it appeared from zero on 5 unrelated keys in the same hour on Oct 27 (Pinterest Login went from 0.2% to 62% of traffic at flat volume): an upstream JA4 dictionary change, not an attack. Dropped as artifacts: cdn-header-order-only-have-single-cookie (created Oct 24) and country-timezone-mismatch (jumps on every key on Oct 25, EU DST end; expect tz-mismatch flags to be noisy until US DST ends Nov 1).

1. g-pagebio-null-cdn-ends-content-length-tz-mismatch-no-vpn-rfc-ct-before-cl livekeep live + review action

Action: Weekend, Oct 16-18: NOT mitigated. Adobe ARP grew to 959k (Oct 16), 1.42M (Oct 17) and 902k (Oct 18), with 59-75% verified. The TT fires, but most of the traffic still gets through. It peaked at 168k/h on Oct 18 12:00 UTC (83% verified) and was down to ~3-4k/h by midnight. This is the top ask: change the action on this key. New keys: WBD Account Lookup (Key 20) 435k on Oct 18 (23% verified; bursts at 06h, 08-09h and 18-20h with a 188k/h peak). WBD Login (Key 8) 203k on Oct 18 (39% verified; 40k/h at 18h and 54k/h at 21-22h). Olo Payments 10k (5% verified, still running). Roblox Signup is steady at ~40k/day.

Appendix — how these were found

Daily run 2026-10-28, window Oct 24-27 (full 4 days; the unmodified step-1 query timed out once and ran on the identical re-send, no narrowing). Step 1: 40 flags with >=3 keys spiking. Dropped as artifacts, not attacks: cdn-header-order-only-have-single-cookie (49 keys, ~5.8M/day) was created 2026-10-24 04:30 (c.koay, ticket 140244), baseline 0. country-timezone-mismatch (56 keys) is not edited (2023), but it steps from ~31k to ~84k sampled/day on every key at once on Oct 25, the day EU DST ended (US ends Nov 1). That is a calendar/timezone-table artifact; the same step will distort tz-mismatch flags until ~Nov 1. g-ip-connection-type-velocity-short-term-abuse-wired-1point5x/2x/3x: rule rewritten Oct 21 (key_a/key_b -> key/value), 0 before Oct 21, so 3 of 7 baseline days are ~0 (same call as the Oct 22 run). Spike-scan TT names created Oct 19-20 (g-cdn-ends-cl-rfc-ct-before-cl-tz-mismatch-grease 5 keys, g-rfc-ct-before-cl-device-param-spoofing-di-dict3-st-1x 3 keys): still treated as artifacts, because their names entered TELLTALE_LIST from zero inside the Oct 17-23 baseline. Duplicates: ja4-dict-1-challenger-is-supicious-not-included (= ja4-dict-1-challenger) and sus-flag-cdn-header-order-has-sec-fetch-user (= g-cdn-header-order-has-sec-fetch-user). Kept with a caveat: g-di-dict-7 1x/4x and g-di-dict-15 4x were edited 2026-10-27 03:36-04:02 (m.davies; 1x changed from threshold_breached to short_term_threshold_ratio >= 3). That is stricter and their baseline is not ~0, so the window spikes are not caused by the edit, but Oct 27 counts are on the new definition. Top surviving single flags: g-di-dict-7 1x on 8 keys (Amazon IDS K2 ~83k/day vs 14k, gtop100 66k vs 11k, Highlight AI Chat 54k vs 1k, BofA Beacon ATM 22k vs 0, Airbnb Account Lookup 11k vs 0); g-di-high-risk-signature-2x-LT on 7 (BofA Beacon ATM 137k vs 0, Microsoft Identity Signup 131k vs 36k, Amazon IDS 45k, Tinder PreSMS 39k, DoorDash 20k); ja4-dict-1-challenger on 7 (Pinterest Login 156k vs 2k, Pinterest Reg 19k, AT&T Login 8k, Dropbox, Airbnb, Pinterest Challenge, Figma); bba is-signature 0..1-1..0 on 6 and g-biometric-mouse-sampling-inconsistency on 5 (Adobe Sign Up, Amazon IDS, Microsoft Signup); cdn-header-order-contains-pragma (Amazon IDS 117k vs 24k); client-hints-mobile-ua-not-mobile (Roblox Signup ~1.05M vs 280k); g-cdn-header-order-has-sec-fetch-user and g-ip-velocity-long-term-abuse-2x (Uber SMS 756k and 414k/day). Step 2 (16-flag vocab in the session scratchpad, arity <= 4, limit 20): 12 surviving step-1 flags + g-device-parameter-spoofing, g-page-level-biometrics-empty-or-null, g-di-dict-3 1x and client-hints-has-not-a-brand-grease. The 16-flag cap left out the other tracked-combo flags (rfc ct-before-cl, ends-with-cl/te, tz no-vpn, single-click, rta-isp, high-risk-sig-st, webgl, appleos, sec-fetch-dest, os-spoofing). Only one combo reached keys_spiking >= 5 and spike_share >= 0.5: ja4-dict-1-challenger + di-short-count-300-fp-pixel-ratio-1 (8 keys, share 0.91). It is a subset of live dishort300_dp_spoof_ja4_dict1, but on most keys it fires without g-device-parameter-spoofing (exact Oct 24-27: Roblox Signup K2 231k, 77% verified, 4% with dp-spoof; Pinterest Login 224k, 99% verified; Roblox Login 36k, 3% verified; gtop100 34k, 66% verified, 98% = live triple; Pinterest Reg 30k, 99% verified; Airbnb Account Lookup 9.2k, 70% verified; Wells Fargo Login 8.7k, 52% verified; Adobe ARP FF 7.4k, 16% verified). Not proposed: the pair appears from 0 on 5 unrelated keys at the same hour (Oct 27 ~06 UTC). On Pinterest Login ja4-dict-1 went from ~0.2% to ~62% of traffic with flat volume. That points to an upstream JA4 dictionary or client change. Roblox Signup was a one-day Oct 24 burst at 78% verified. Watch Roblox Login (36k, 3% verified, started Oct 27) and Adobe ARP FF. Every other combo with >= 5 keys had share <= 0.38 (dict-7 + grease/dp-spoof/pagebio 0.29-0.38 on Amazon IDS, gtop100, Highlight AI, BofA ATM, Microsoft Signup, Airbnb, Blizzard ROW Login, CTM UK; sec-ch-ua upcoming-chrome + grease 0.30; pragma + grease 0.13; ja4 + pagebio 0.04), so they are not attack-specific. No new candidates; no drafts validated; combos.json unchanged.
